name: genesis-wasm
description: WebAssembly bindings for PDF text extraction and verification (requires the Rust toolchain with cargo)

scripts.cargo: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const args = process.argv.slice(1); const result = spawnSync('cargo', args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error && result.error.code === 'ENOENT') { console.error('Rust toolchain with cargo is required.'); process.exit(1); } if (result.error) { console.error(result.error.message); process.exit(1); } process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
